title: QAQ: Bidirectional Semantic Coherence for Selecting High-Quality Synthetic Code Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2603.12165v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synthetic data has become essential for training code generation models, yet it introduces significant noise and hallucinations that are difficult to detect with current metrics. Existing data selection methods like Instruction-Following Difficulty (IFD) typically assess how hard a model generates an answer given a query ($A|Q$). However, this metric is ambiguous on noisy synthetic data, where low probability can distinguish between intrinsic task complexity and model-generated hallucinations. Here, we propose QAQ, a novel data selection framework that evaluates data quality from the reverse direction: how well can the answer predict the query ($Q|A$)? We define Reverse Mutual Information (RMI) to quantify the information gain about the query conditioned on the answer. translated_title: QAQ：基于双向语义一致性的高质量合成代码指令选择方法
translated_abstract: 合成数据已成为训练代码生成模型不可或缺的资源，然而它引入了大量噪声和幻觉，这些难以用现有指标检测。诸如指令跟随难度（IFD）等现有数据选择方法通常评估模型在给定查询条件下生成答案的难度（A|Q）。然而，该指标在含噪合成数据上存在歧义性，因为低概率既可能反映任务本身的内在复杂性，也可能反映模型生成的幻觉。为此，我们提出了QAQ，一种从反方向评估数据质量的新型数据选择框架：答案能在多大程度上预测查询（Q|A）？我们定义了反向互信息（RMI）来量化以答案为条件下关于查询的信息增益。我们的分析表明，RMI的两个极端都预示着质量问题：低RMI表明语义不对齐，而过高的RMI则可能包含缺陷模式……
tldr: 提出QAQ数据选择框架，通过反向互信息（RMI）从“答案预测查询”的反向视角评估合成代码指令数据的质量，有效识别语义不对齐和缺陷模式等噪声问题。
en_tdlr: QAQ is a novel data selection framework that evaluates synthetic code instruction quality from the reverse direction—predicting the query from the answer—using Reverse Mutual Information (RMI) to identify semantic misalignment and defect patterns in noisy synthetic data.
